clips.title: The story
paras: Novice Alliance mages in Stormwind's Mage Quarter are sent to sample Mirror Lake's waters for magical contamination. Jennea Cannon sends them southwest of the city gates to test the waterfall spray.

Azeroth's arcane currents were shaken by conflicts from the opening of the Dark Portal through the Third War and the battle at Mount Hyjal. Those shocks tore ancient currents from their stable channels. In Stormwind's Wizard's Sanctum, magi like Jennea Cannon watch the changes closely. They fear that displaced arcane power could reach the wilderness and corrupt local ecosystems.

Mirror Lake lies beneath the cliffs southwest of the Stormwind gates and is a primary natural reservoir fed by mountain falls. The surrounding countryside depends on its waters. Jennea sends novice mages with a glass flask to the waterfall's base, where they collect fresh spray. The Sanctum can then use scrying and reagent tests to learn whether wild magic is seeping into the public water supply.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: This world has been victim to massive mystic struggles, which tore magic currents from once stable channels. We struggle to determine the effects these changes have caused, and some of us fear the worst!
But I will reveal more of this later. Right now, we need you to gather information.

Here, take this flask. Go to the base of the waterfall at Mirror Lake, southwest of the Stormwind gates, and retrieve a sample of the water there. Return it to me so that I might test it for magical taints.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you have the sample, friend? The flow of magic in Stormwind and Elwynn has been altered, and I must know if it is seeping into the water.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thank you, friend. I will test this water for magical properties. Let us hope that it contains none, or we may find that those who drink from Mirror Lake for too long will be adversely affected.
Here, friend. Take this orb or staff as a token of your service. May it serve you well.
